title: Definitely Working
question: Is this work?
scope: Same paid office job, during scheduled hours. Judge the activity, not whether the boss allows it.

cases.label: Writing the report yourself
cases.body: You produce an accurate report for your assigned task.

scene.alt: A person writing an assigned report.

cases.label: AI writes it. You check every fact.
cases.body: Same accurate report for the same task. You review it before submission.

scene.alt: An AI-written assigned report with every fact checked.

cases.label: The identical AI report, submitted unread
cases.body: Same accurate output. You submit it without opening or checking it.

scene.alt: The identical accurate AI report submitted without review.

cases.label: Solving the work problem on a walk
cases.body: You actively think through the assigned problem and make progress.

scene.alt: A person making progress on a work problem while walking.

cases.label: The same thinking, while buying groceries
cases.body: Same problem and progress on the same walk. You also pick up groceries.

scene.alt: The same work thinking and progress while also buying groceries.

cases.label: Mouse jiggler on. Television on.
cases.body: Your status stays active while you watch a sitcom. No work gets done.

scene.alt: A mouse jiggler keeping status active while its owner watches TV.

cases.label: Checking only one typo in the AI report
cases.body: The accurate AI report is unchanged except one corrected typo. No factual review.

scene.alt: An AI report with a single typo corrected.

cases.label: A nap that produces the solution
cases.body: You fall asleep thinking about the work problem and wake with its solution.

scene.alt: A nap followed by a solution to the assigned work problem.

cases.label: Mandatory team-building karaoke
cases.body: Attendance is required during paid working hours.

scene.alt: Required team-building karaoke during working hours.

cases.label: Playing a game during a status call
cases.body: Camera off. You play a game and hear everything, but contribute nothing.

scene.alt: A person gaming while listening silently to a status call.

cases.label: An automated report runs while you relax
cases.body: You built the automation earlier. Today's assigned report is accurate and delivered without your involvement.

scene.alt: An accurate assigned report delivered by previously built automation.

cases.label: Solving the work problem at the pub
cases.body: During scheduled hours, you and a coworker solve the assigned problem over a drink.

scene.alt: Two coworkers solving an assigned work problem at a pub.

comparisons.headline: Same output. Different review.
comparisons.line: The checked AI report was work. The unread copy was not.

comparisons.headline: Checking changed the call.
comparisons.line: The checked report was not work. The unread copy was.

comparisons.headline: The thinking stayed the same.
comparisons.line: Adding the grocery stop got a different call.

comparisons.headline: Groceries got it promoted.
comparisons.line: The same work thinking counted only with the grocery stop.

comparisons.headline: Same assigned report. Different process.
comparisons.line: Writing it yourself counted. Checking the AI draft did not.

receiptRules.headline: Quality control has entered the chat.
receiptRules.line: The accurate AI report counted after checking, but not unread.

receiptRules.headline: Inspection somehow failed inspection.
receiptRules.line: The unread AI report counted. Checking it did not.

receiptRules.headline: The groceries got it fired.
receiptRules.line: The same thinking counted until the grocery stop was added.

receiptRules.headline: Promoted by a bag of groceries.
receiptRules.line: The same thinking counted only with the grocery stop.

receiptRules.headline: The keyboard wants its credit.
receiptRules.line: Writing the report counted. Checking the accurate AI version did not.

receiptFallback.headline: Your clipboard says the day is over.
receiptFallback.line: Eight calls recorded. This receipt is not a performance review.
